A [[Mon Calamari]] [[Gender|male]] was a '''nobleman''' and the [[Parent|father]] of a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari nobleman's son|Mon Calamari]] who hid in the [[ocean]] dunes of [[Karnac]] after skipping bail during the [[New Republic Era]]. A [[bounty]] was later placed on the [[noble]]man's son, which was acquired and subsequently abandoned by the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]]<ref name="Chapter 3" /> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date Note">{{MandoDate|3}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mon Calamari nobleman was mentioned in [[Chapter 3: The Sin|Chapter 3]] of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 3" /> which aired on [[November 22]], 2019.<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref>
